subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: What recovery and delivery-idempotency contract should close this combined compaction-timeout, duplicate-send, and poisoned-session report?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses session-state cleanup, Telegram/outbound delivery semantics, and operator recovery UX, so a narrow autonomous patch cannot safely choose the product boundary.

options.title: Keep as combined incident
options.body: Use #43661 as the concrete P0 incident while #92899 and broader lifecycle work land, then close only after duplicate sends and poisoned-session recovery are proven.

options.title: Split into owner trackers
options.body: Close this only after maintainers create or designate separate canonical issues for compaction progress, duplicate Telegram delivery, and poisoned-session recovery.

options.title: Accept partial mitigation
options.body: Treat #92899 and current recovery docs as sufficient and leave duplicate-send or manual recovery gaps outside the core guarantee.

recommendation.title: Keep as combined incident
recommendation.body: Use #43661 as the concrete P0 incident while #92899 and broader lifecycle work land, then close only after duplicate sends and poisoned-session recovery are proven.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee on this issue and on the active partial-progress PR, and is best positioned to choose the owner boundary.
